sahneler.anlatim: Valve's latest Counter-Strike 2 update puts Singapore 2026 Major tournament items on sale.
According to Valve's Steam announcement, Viewer Passes and autograph stickers are now in the Major Shop.

veri.alinti: Major Viewer Passes and Team and Player Autograph stickers are now available for purchase in the Major Shop.

sahneler.anlatim: A Viewer Pass unlocks a Bronze Challenge Coin. Autograph stickers have a fixed price. Half of the proceeds go to players, teams and the tournament organizer.

maddeler.metin: Bronze Challenge Coin with a pass
50% of proceeds to players and teams

sahneler.anlatim: The update also adds 8 new Monstercat music kits, from Tristam & Braken's classic release to Noisestorm's viral April Fool's joke.
All the Singapore 2026 Major items are on our site, Control A Game.
